IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — GPU driver resets detected in inference-prod-us-west-2. Cluster pool 'inference-prod' reporting repeated Xid=31 and ECC parity spikes on multiple hosts (gw-11, gw-13, gw-17). Event rate ~0.8/min. Possible container OOMs. Severity P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-driver-reset

PagerDutyBot: Incident INC-2026-3783 created and assigned to Alice Chen.

Alice Chen: Oncall here. Acknowledging. Starting initial triage. Which hosts show container crashes vs full node flaps?

Raj Patel: on runtime — looking at metrics now. Can you paste dmesg + nvidia logs from gw-11 and gw-13? Suspect Xid 31 (illegal memory access) vs persistent ECC errors.

Maria Gomez: Infra here — noticed PCIe AER counters jump on gw-11 after 03:12 UTC. No kernel upgrade in last 48h. I'll start tails on journal: `sudo journalctl -kf -u kubelet` and nv-host logs.

Sam Ortiz: Support opening a customer bridge for impacted tenants. Notifying top customers: AcmeCorp, BetaApps. Bridge URL: https://bridge.redwood/INC-2026-3783

Alice Chen: Quick mitigation plan:
1) cordon gw-11 and gw-13 to stop new workloads
2) drain with graceful 2m, ignore daemonsets
3) restart runtime-agent and gpu-drivers on drained nodes
4) roll traffic to spare hosts (gw-20..gw-24) using Canary routing
5) collect dmesg & nv-host logs and attach to ticket

Commands I'm running:
```bash
kubectl cordon gw-11 gw-13
kubectl drain gw-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
systemctl restart runtime-agent
journalctl -u nvidia-driver -n 200 --no-pager > /tmp/gw-11-nvidia.log
```

Maria Gomez: Running step 1/2. Starting drain on gw-11 now. Watchdog: if Xid spikes during drain, abort and isolate node.

EngRuntime: Recommending disabling large-batch path for affected model endpoints until we confirm KV cache integrity. Pushing routing override to exclude gw-11/gw-13.

Alice Chen: Applied routing override. Also toggling infer.batch.max_tokens=256 for critical endpoints (temp).

Raj Patel: Sample dmesg from gw-11:
```
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID=32456, gpu=0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  323.234567] nvidia: probe failed with error -5
[  324.000101] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 32456 (model-runtime) score 125 or sacrifice child
```

SupportTeamLead: Customer impact summary: 3 tenants reported increased 5xx errors and latency spikes (AcmeCorp, BetaApps, GammaML). 1 job failed with OOM on AcmeCorp. We've posted interim message to customer bridge.

Sam Ortiz: Bridge check-in: customers on call. AcmeCorp asked for ETA — giving 45m optimistic if node reboots and driver reload fix it.

Maria Gomez: Completed drain on gw-11; restarting node driver stack with warm reboot (no BIOS cycle) to avoid long reprovisioning. Commands: `sudo systemctl stop kubelet && rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia && modprobe nvidia && systemctl start kubelet`

Alice Chen: Observed one container crashloop earlier, but after drain traffic rerouted, error rate dropped from 0.9/min to 0.15/min. Monitoring panels: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/driver-resets

EngRuntime: Runtime agent restarted on gw-11. Flushed KV cache for pinned models. We'll keep quantization off for now.

Raj Patel: NV-host log tail showing ECC parity counts reducing post-restart. Still seeing occasional Xid 31 on gw-13. Need to isolate gw-13 if it continues.

InfraSRE: gw-13 currently under observation. I've cabled up spare host gw-24 for fast scheduling if we need capacity. Also capturing hw telemetry: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,POWER,FB`

Alice Chen: Handoff note for day oncall (Sam) in 15m: nodes cordoned/drained, runtime-agent restarted on gw-11. gw-13 is next candidate for drain if Xid persists. Customer bridge up; customers notified. Keep severity P2 and reopen if error rate > 0.5/min or new 5xx spikes.

SupportTeamLead: Updated customers: detailed post with mitigation steps and ETA. Tracking ticket INC-2026-3783-ACME.

IncidentBot: Status update — mitigations applied: nodes cordoned (gw-11), runtime-agent restart, routing override active. Error rate now 0.12/min.

Raj Patel: Follow-up action items: collect full nv-host logs (past 24h) and attach to the incident, run memtest on gw-13 if failures continue, consider swapping GPUs if parity returns.

Sam Ortiz: Acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor the bridge and watch metrics for 2 hours. Will escalate to oncall-sre if Xid returns or if we see new OOMs.

Alice Chen: :white_check_mark: Good job team. Leaving detailed notes in the incident ticket and tagging this thread for postmortem. Handoff complete.

SupportTeamLead: Closing customer bridge for now; will reopen if regression.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-3783 moved to monitoring state by Alice Chen.
